blogPosts.title: How Much Does a New Boiler Cost in Horsham? A Complete 2026 Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover what Horsham homeowners can expect to pay for a new boiler in 2026, including installation, brands and factors that affect the final price.
body: If you are a Horsham homeowner wondering how much a new boiler will cost in 2026, you are not alone. Replacing a boiler is one of the most significant home improvement decisions you will make, and understanding the pricing landscape in West Sussex is essential before committing. At Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering, we have fitted hundreds of boilers across Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we know that every property has different requirements. The cost of a new boiler in Horsham typically starts from around £1,999 for a standard combi installation, but the final price depends on several important factors that are specific to your home.

The type of boiler you choose has the single biggest impact on cost. Combi boilers remain the most popular choice for Horsham homes because they provide instant hot water and heating without the need for a separate water tank or cylinder. For a typical Horsham semi-detached or terraced property, a quality-brand combi boiler — such as a Viessmann, Worcester Bosch or Ideal — will usually cost between £1,999 and £2,800 fully installed. System boilers, which use a separate hot water cylinder, are a better fit for larger Horsham properties with multiple bathrooms, and these typically range from £2,500 to £3,500 installed. Conventional boilers with a full tank and cylinder setup are less common in new installations but may be necessary for certain older Horsham homes, with costs running slightly higher.

Beyond the boiler itself, several property-specific factors influence the total installation cost in Horsham. The condition of your existing pipework is critical — if your Horsham home has older copper or steel pipework that needs upgrading to meet current standards, this will add to the overall price. The complexity of the installation location matters too: a straightforward swap in the same position is considerably cheaper than relocating a boiler to a different room or from an interior cupboard to an exterior wall. Horsham homes built in different eras present different challenges — Victorian and Edwardian properties in the town centre may require additional pipework runs, while newer builds on developments like North Horsham tend to have more accessible installation points.

Energy efficiency ratings are a major consideration for Horsham homeowners in 2026, especially with energy prices remaining a concern across the UK. All new boilers installed in the UK must be A-rated condensing boilers, which means they convert at least 92% of their fuel into usable heat. For a typical Horsham household, upgrading from an old, G-rated boiler to a modern A-rated system can save hundreds of pounds per year on energy bills. This is particularly relevant in Horsham, where many homes still have boilers that are 15 to 20 years old and operating well below their original efficiency. When we quote for a new boiler installation in Horsham, we always factor in the long-term savings that a modern, efficient system will deliver.

Warranty length is another key factor when comparing boiler costs in Horsham. Budget boilers may offer a standard 5-year warranty, while premium brands like Viessmann and Worcester Bosch provide warranties of up to 12 years when installed by an approved engineer. At Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering, we only supply and install boilers from manufacturers we trust, and we ensure every Horsham customer receives the full manufacturer warranty that comes with their new system. This means if anything goes wrong with your boiler during the warranty period, you are covered for parts and often labour — giving you genuine peace of mind.

It is also worth considering the additional costs that come with a boiler replacement in Horsham. A new magnetic system filter, which protects your heating system from sludge and debris, typically adds £100 to £150 to the installation. A system powerflush, which cleans out your existing pipework before the new boiler is fitted, costs between £300 and £500 depending on the size of your Horsham property. Smart thermostat upgrades — such as Nest or Hive — are an optional extra but are increasingly popular with Horsham homeowners looking to control their heating remotely and reduce energy waste. When you request a quote from Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering for a new boiler in Horsham, we provide a fully itemised breakdown so you know exactly what you are paying for.

The best time to replace your boiler in Horsham depends on your current system's condition. If your boiler is over 10 years old, frequently breaking down, or producing a carbon monoxide warning, replacement should be a priority rather than a repair. Many Horsham homeowners choose to replace their boiler in the autumn months — September and October — before the cold weather arrives, which avoids the rush for emergency call-outs during the winter. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering offers free, no-obligation quotes for boiler installations across Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, so you can make an informed decision without any pressure.

To find out exactly how much a new boiler will cost for your Horsham home, call Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering on 01403 814602 or email andrew.t.s.tyler@hotmail.co.uk. We will assess your property, discuss your heating needs, and provide a fixed, upfront quote — all completely free of charge. As Horsham's trusted gas engineer, we are committed to quality-brand products, transparent pricing and workmanship you can rely on.

blogPosts.title: Boiler Breakdown? What Horsham Homeowners Should Do in a Winter Emergency
blogPosts.excerpt: A step-by-step guide for Horsham homeowners dealing with a boiler breakdown during the cold West Sussex winter months.
body: A boiler breakdown is one of the most stressful home emergencies any Horsham homeowner can face, particularly during the cold winter months when temperatures across West Sussex regularly drop below freezing. When your heating stops working and the hot water runs cold, knowing exactly what to do — and who to call — can make the difference between a quick fix and a prolonged, uncomfortable ordeal. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering provides emergency boiler breakdown services across Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we have put together this guide to help Horsham residents respond quickly and safely when their boiler fails.

The first thing to do when your boiler stops working in Horsham is to check the basics before calling an engineer. Start by checking that your boiler's display panel is showing an error code — most modern boilers display a fault code that can help diagnose the problem quickly. Next, check your gas supply: make sure the gas meter has credit if you are on a prepayment meter, and verify that the gas isolation valve is in the open position. Check the pressure gauge on your boiler — if it reads below 1 bar, your system may have lost pressure and simply needs repressurising, which is a straightforward fix that many Horsham homeowners can do themselves using the filling loop beneath the boiler.

If your boiler is displaying a specific error code, make a note of it before calling your Horsham gas engineer. Common boiler fault codes in West Sussex properties include low pressure warnings, ignition failures, and overheat lockouts. These codes help us diagnose the issue before we arrive at your Horsham property, which means we can often bring the correct parts with us and complete the repair in a single visit. At Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering, we maintain a stock of commonly needed boiler parts specifically for Horsham and surrounding area call-outs, which significantly reduces the time your home is without heating.

Safety must always be the priority during a boiler breakdown in Horsham. If you smell gas — a distinctive rotten egg odour — leave your property immediately, do not operate any light switches or electrical devices, and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999 before contacting your gas engineer. Never attempt to repair a gas boiler yourself if you are not Gas Safe registered. Carbon monoxide is another serious concern during boiler failures: if your carbon monoxide detector is sounding, evacuate the property immediately and seek medical attention if you feel unwell. Horsham homeowners should ensure they have working carbon monoxide detectors on every floor of their property — it is not just best practice, it is a legal requirement in rental properties.

Keeping your Horsham home warm while waiting for your emergency boiler repair is important, especially if you have young children, elderly family members or vulnerable individuals in the household. Use portable electric heaters safely — never use a gas oven or hob to heat your rooms, as this produces dangerous levels of carbon monoxide. Thick curtains, draught excluders and extra blankets can make a significant difference in Horsham homes during the short period before your engineer arrives. If the breakdown occurs overnight or on a weekend, Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering offers same-day emergency call-outs across Horsham, so you will not be left waiting until Monday morning.

Prevention is always better than cure when it comes to boiler breakdowns in Horsham. Annual boiler servicing is the single most effective way to avoid unexpected failures during the winter months. During a service, a Gas Safe registered engineer will inspect your boiler's internal components, check for gas leaks, test the flue and combustion rates, and identify any developing problems before they cause a full breakdown. Horsham homeowners who service their boilers every year experience significantly fewer emergency call-outs and enjoy better energy efficiency throughout the heating season. At Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering, we recommend scheduling your annual boiler service in the autumn — September or October — to ensure your system is ready for the West Sussex winter.

When choosing an emergency gas engineer in Horsham, always verify their Gas Safe registration. You can check any engineer's credentials on the Gas Safe Register website using their licence number. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering is fully Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and experienced in repairing all major boiler brands found in Horsham homes. We provide upfront pricing before any repair work begins, so there are no surprises on the bill. Whether your Horsham boiler needs a simple pressure reset or a full component replacement, we have the expertise and parts to get your heating and hot water restored quickly.

Do not wait until your boiler breaks down on the coldest night of the year. If your Horsham boiler is showing signs of age — frequent fault codes, unusual noises, rising energy bills or inconsistent heating — call Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering on 01403 814602 for an honest assessment. We serve Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we are always happy to advise whether a repair or replacement is the most cost-effective solution for your West Sussex home.

blogPosts.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates in Horsham — What You Need to Know in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to CP12 gas safety certificates for Horsham landlords, including legal requirements, costs and how to stay compliant.
body: If you are a landlord with rental property in Horsham, a valid gas safety certificate — known as a CP12 — is not optional. It is a legal requirement under the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, and failure to hold a current certificate can result in fines of up to £6,000 or even imprisonment. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering is a trusted gas engineer serving Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we help landlords across West Sussex stay fully compliant with their gas safety obligations every year.

The legal framework around gas safety certificates for Horsham landlords is straightforward but strict. Every landlord — whether you own a single buy-to-let or a portfolio of rental properties across West Sussex — must have a CP12 certificate for every property that has gas appliances. This includes boilers, gas cookers, gas fires and any other gas-fuelled equipment. The inspection must be carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer, and the certificate is valid for 12 months from the date of the inspection. You must provide a copy of the current certificate to your tenants before they move in, or within 28 days of the inspection if they are already in situ.

The cost of a gas safety certificate in Horsham varies depending on the number of gas appliances in the property and the number of rooms that need inspecting. For a standard Horsham rental property with a boiler and a gas cooker, expect to pay between £70 and £95 for a comprehensive CP12 inspection. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering provides competitive pricing for Horsham landlords, and we offer discounts for portfolio landlords who manage multiple properties across Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea. The inspection itself typically takes between 30 and 60 minutes, and we issue the certificate on the same day as the inspection — so there is no delay in getting your documentation to your tenants or letting agent.

During a gas safety inspection for your Horsham rental property, the Gas Safe registered engineer will check every gas appliance and fitting within the property. This includes testing for gas leaks, checking the operating pressure, ensuring adequate ventilation, verifying the flue and combustion performance, and confirming that all safety devices are functioning correctly. The engineer will also visually inspect the condition of pipework and check that the gas meter and emergency isolation valve are accessible and operational. If any appliance fails the inspection, the engineer will classify it as 'Immediately Dangerous' or 'At Risk' and you will be required to disconnect or repair the appliance before the certificate can be issued.

For Horsham landlords, the consequences of not having a valid gas safety certificate are severe. Local authority enforcement officers have the power to issue immediate prohibition notices preventing you from renting out the property, and courts can impose unlimited fines for the most serious breaches. Beyond the legal penalties, an invalid gas safety certificate can invalidate your landlord insurance, create problems with your mortgage lender, and put your tenants at serious risk of gas leaks and carbon monoxide poisoning. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering makes it easy for Horsham landlords to stay compliant — we provide reminders when your certificate is due for renewal and offer priority booking so you are never caught out.

If you are a letting agent managing properties on behalf of landlords in Horsham, maintaining gas safety compliance across your portfolio is critical. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering works with several letting agents across Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, providing coordinated gas safety inspections that keep entire portfolios up to date. We can schedule inspections in bulk, issue certificates directly to your office, and provide a digital copy for your records. Our B2B service for letting agents means you have a single, reliable gas engineer you can trust to keep your landlords compliant and your tenants safe.

Horsham landlords should also be aware that gas safety obligations extend beyond the annual CP12 inspection. You are responsible for maintaining all gas appliances in your rental property in safe working order, and you must ensure that any repair or installation work is carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer. If a tenant reports a gas leak or a faulty boiler, you have a legal duty to arrange a prompt repair — this is where Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering's same-day Horsham call-out service becomes invaluable for landlords who need urgent assistance.

To arrange a gas safety certificate inspection for your Horsham rental property, call Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering on 01403 814602 or email andrew.t.s.tyler@hotmail.co.uk. We cover Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we are happy to provide a fixed quote before booking your inspection. Stay compliant, keep your tenants safe, and avoid costly penalties — book your Horsham CP12 with a trusted local gas engineer today.

blogPosts.title: Smart Thermostat Installation in Horsham — Cut Your Heating Bills in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Find out how Horsham homeowners can save money on energy bills with a professionally installed smart thermostat from a local gas engineer.
body: Horsham homeowners are increasingly turning to smart thermostats to take control of their heating and reduce energy bills, and with good reason. A professionally installed smart thermostat can save the average UK household between £100 and £200 per year on heating costs, and in a town like Horsham where winter temperatures regularly fall to 1 or 2 degrees Celsius, those savings add up quickly. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering provides expert smart thermostat installation across Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, helping local homeowners modernise their heating controls and start saving from day one.

Smart thermostats differ from traditional programmable timers in one fundamental way — they learn your routine and adapt your heating automatically. Devices like the Nest Learning Thermostat, Hive Active Heating and Tado Smart Thermostat use occupancy sensors, weather data and machine learning to understand when you are home, when you are away, and what temperature you prefer. For Horsham homeowners who commute to London or work variable hours, this intelligent control means your heating is only running when you actually need it, eliminating the waste that comes with manually programming a traditional timer. Over the course of a West Sussex winter, this intelligent scheduling can make a substantial difference to your energy bills.

The installation process for a smart thermostat in a Horsham property is typically straightforward when carried out by a qualified gas engineer. Most smart thermostats require a wired connection to your existing heating system, and a professional installation ensures the device is correctly paired with your boiler and configured for optimal performance. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering handles the full installation process — from assessing your current heating controls to wiring, mounting and configuring your new smart thermostat. We also take the time to show you how to use the system, connect it to your smartphone, and set up the features that will save you the most money in your specific Horsham home.

Choosing the right smart thermostat for your Horsham property depends on your heating system and your personal preferences. Nest is the most popular choice for many Horsham homeowners because of its sleek design, intuitive learning capability and excellent integration with Google Home and other smart home devices. Hive, developed by British Gas, offers a clean, user-friendly app and works particularly well with combi boilers commonly found in Horsham homes. Tado is an excellent option for Horsham properties with multiple heating zones, as its individual room sensors allow you to heat only the rooms you are using. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering will advise you on the best smart thermostat for your Horsham property during a free consultation.

One of the most significant advantages of smart thermostat installation for Horsham homeowners is the ability to control your heating remotely via your smartphone. If you are heading home from work in Brighton or Crawley, you can switch on your heating before you leave so your Horsham home is warm when you arrive — without having to heat an empty house all day. This geofencing feature, which uses your phone's location to detect when you are approaching home, is one of the smart thermostat features our Horsham customers use most. It is particularly valuable during the unpredictable West Sussex weather, when conditions can change rapidly throughout the day.

Beyond cost savings, smart thermostats contribute to reducing your home's carbon footprint — an increasingly important consideration for environmentally conscious Horsham residents. By ensuring your heating runs only when needed and at the optimal temperature, a smart thermostat can reduce your household's carbon emissions by a meaningful margin each year. For Horsham homeowners who have invested in solar panels or are considering renewable energy options, a smart thermostat integrates seamlessly into a broader home energy strategy. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering is committed to helping Horsham households become more energy-efficient, and smart thermostat installation is one of the most cost-effective steps you can take.

The upfront cost of a smart thermostat in Horsham is surprisingly affordable. Nest and Hive units typically cost between £150 and £220 for the hardware, with professional installation by a Gas Safe registered engineer adding a modest fee. Given that the average Horsham household can save £100 or more per year on heating bills, the system often pays for itself within the first two winters. Andrew Tyler Gas Engineering provides a fixed, upfront quote for smart thermostat installation in Horsham, so you know the total cost before we begin any work.

We serve Horsham, Crawley, Brighton, Hove and Shoreham-by-Sea, and we are happy to recommend the best smart thermostat for your property and heating system.
